snippet.title: Sam the Boulderman (Net Yaroze) Gameplay
snippet.description: This is a footage of me playing Euro Demo 84, thanks to Tobi! The Net Yaroze compilation is mostly awful, except for Shroud (a Defender clone). I checked one of the games which is Sam the Boulderman and, let me tell you, it is worse than Rocks 'n' Gems. It has ripped sounds from Clone, a better Net Yaroze game in my opinion. At least Rocks 'n' Gems had some nostalgia factor, this one just doesn't. Well done, James.
